title: Implement matrix multiplication with delayed-reduction kernels
description:
Blocked matrix multiplication using `FieldVec::dot_product` as the inner kernel. Bounds-aware reduction scheduling via `FiniteField::Wide` and `max_unreduced_additions()`, following fflas-ffpack's `MMHelper` pattern and the Winograd bound from Dumas–Pernet §1.4 theorem 4.

Also implements the proxy-type operator overloads designed in story `cdcebf6a`.

## Algorithms

- **Classical blocked**: Block size tuned for L1/L2 cache, each block uses vectorized `FieldVec::dot_product` with delayed reduction.
- **Strassen–Winograd**: 7-mult/15-add recursive algorithm (paper §1.4, alg 1.6), with conservative bounds propagation through sub-problems per theorem 4 `(1+3^l)/2 × ceil(k/2^l) × (p−1)²`. Gated by matrix size threshold (configurable `WINO_THRESHOLD`).
- **SIMD dispatch**: Route to `FieldBackend` kernels for supported field types (AVX2, AVX-512 IFMA).

## Proxy types (per `cdcebf6a` design)

- `Product<A, B>`, `Sum<A, B>`, `Scale<F, M>`, `FusedProductPlus<A·B, C>`, `Transposed<M>` — concrete types behind the `Mul`/`Add`/`Sub`/`Neg` op-trait impls.
- `Evaluate<F>` trait with `evaluate_into(&mut FieldMatrix<F>)` implemented for every proxy.
- Canonical fusions: `A·B + βC` → one fgemm call; `αA + B`; `Aᵀ·B`; `αAᵀ·B + βC`.
- All four owned/ref combinations of `Mul`/`Add`/`Sub` covered (BitMatrix precedent).
- Scalar multiplication: `F * &M` and `&M * F`.

## Success criteria

- [hard] `gemm` correct across GF(7), GF(65521), GF(2^31-1), GF(2^8), GF(2^16); verified by cross-checking with naive triple-loop on small sizes and by property-based associativity / distributivity tests.
- [hard] Delayed reduction bounds respected — `debug_assert!` kmax invariants at every accumulation boundary.
- [hard] Strassen–Winograd path produces bit-exact results vs. classical path at all threshold crossovers.
- [hard] Proxy types from `cdcebf6a` design implemented; canonical fusions collapse to one kernel call (verified by trace counters in debug builds).
- [hard] All four owned/ref combinations of `Mul`/`Add`/`Sub` implemented.
- [hard] Scalar multiplication `F * &M` and `&M * F` both work.
- [hard] Criterion micro-benchmarks at n = 64, 256, 1024, 4096 for GF(2^31-1) and GF(2^8).
- [hard] Within 2× of fflas-ffpack on GF(p) at n = 1024 (aspirational past that; empirical thresholds recorded in the bench story).
- [aspirational] Exceed fflas-ffpack on GF(2^m) at n ≥ 256.
- [aspirational] Winograd threshold tuned per field; crossover < 2× overhead at the threshold.

- SIMD-accelerated FieldVec (0fb99491) — DONE (in e095a100)
